typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SOURCE as string,
		MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEME_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     \'FACETS\' SOURCE     , SBSB_ID   MEMBERNUMBER     , MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME      , MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME  FROM     FACETS.CMC_UMSV_SERVICES UMSV         INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME             ON (MEME.MEME_CK = UMSV.MEME_CK)          INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB             ON (SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK) WHERE         SEGR_ID = \'AOCI\'     AND TRUNC(UMSV_AUTH_DT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FACETSAuth
FACETSAuth derive(MEMBERNUMBER = toString(MEMBERNUMBER) + '00') ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_SOURCE as string,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_LAST_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_FIRST_NAME = MEME_FIRST_NAME,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_SOURCE = SOURCE,
		CALLLIST_303_AUTH_STAGING_LAST_NAME = MEME_LAST_NAME)) ~> PDSAuthStaging
